question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Pay heed to
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Listen carefully with attention'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom '**Pay heed to**' is** 'Listen carefully with attention'.**
 
• **Pay heed to:** to pay attention to. (पर ध्यान देना)'.
 
 
• *Example: He failed to** pay heed to **our advice.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Listen carefully with attention*
